items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Arthur Prysock was there, too, one of the beautiful voices, but Buddy’s music just fit him so well.

ctx.x: Ella was perfect, singing. Arthur Prysock was there, too, one of the beautiful voices, but Buddy’s music just fit him so well.
Arthur Prysock, one of the many Billy Eckstine – I don’t want to call him clones.
